games.title: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story
games.subtitle: Static recompilation · native PC port
games.status: Work in progress — playable up to the file select screen
games.description: The original ARM9 code is recompiled to C and runs natively on your PC. Graphics, input and the DS hardware are reimplemented. No game data is included: you provide your own copy of the game.

launch.buildHint: The game has not been built yet. Run recomp\runtime\run_pc.bat once.
